races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Fillies' Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Rose Cotton
runners_data.comment: A winner four starts back, then two runner-up efforts in a row, with sevenths at the start and end of the five-run sequence. Has raced over today's trip before but returns from a 60-day break under 142 lb, that below-par latest run the obvious concern.

runners_data.name: Post Rider
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in her last five starts, but a third two starts back, and a runner-up four starts back, show she has the class for this. Quick to reappear 13 days on, and narrowly the pick of this field on our figures.

runners_data.name: Sound Janet
runners_data.comment: Two runner-up efforts four and five starts back show ability, though form has dipped since — fifth, unplaced, then sixth last time out. Has raced over today's trip before with a strong speed figure to her name; the recent decline is the main concern.

runners_data.name: Ghost Story
runners_data.comment: A winner five starts back, runner-up four starts back, then three straight thirds — competitive throughout. Has raced over today's trip before, and her speed figure matches her rating; the query is finding more than minor honours here.

runners_data.name: Lady Magu
runners_data.comment: Won last time out after two fifth-placed efforts before that, marking a clear step forward. Carries 131 lb on a 27-day turnaround, with an official rating of 75 that leaves room to progress if that improved form is repeated.

runners_data.name: Shangri La
runners_data.comment: Without a win in her last three starts, albeit a third last time out was the best of them after two fourths before that. A 220-day absence since raises obvious fitness questions, though her official rating of 73 is competitive; her modest speed figure is the concern.

runners_data.name: Guendolen
runners_data.comment: Well held in her last three starts (6th, 7th, 6th) having been fourth in the two before that, without landing a win in her last five outings. Has raced over today's trip before, but a 75-day break and a downward drift in form make her hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Five Moons
runners_data.comment: Three fourths in her last three starts follow a seventh four back, without a win to show for any of them. Has raced over today's trip before but returns from a 120-day layoff and rates bottom of this field on our figures.

runners_data.name: Desert Belle
runners_data.comment: A third last time out tops a good recent run. A winner three starts back, runner-up four starts back, with only a fourth to interrupt. Has raced over today's trip before, fit again 34 days on.

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Restricted Maiden Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Jungle Drums
runners_data.comment: A winner four starts back is the standout. Unplaced twice since, then a fifth last time out. Distance-proven, fresh after 37 days off and ranked fourth of eleven on our figures — capable of running to that peak again.

runners_data.name: Night Storm
runners_data.comment: Two wins in its last four starts, following up with a third and a fourth. Distance-proven, fresh after 24 days off, and rated marginally above its official mark on our figures — enough in the profile for this to be the pick.

runners_data.name: Moving Force
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last five starts but ran a solid second two starts back, among otherwise modest efforts. Distance-proven and fresh after 33 days off, ranked third of eleven on our figures — the runner-up form is the case for a bigger run today.

runners_data.name: American Style
runners_data.comment: Winless in its last five starts, with a third four starts back the standout among modest form since. Distance-proven and race-fit after a run just 13 days ago, ranked fifth of eleven on our figures — the recent dip is the concern.

runners_data.name: Aigeas
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and again five starts back, with a fifth and an eighth sandwiched between. Distance-proven and race-fit after just 12 days off, ranked eighth of eleven on our figures — the fresh win is the headline, the inconsistency either side the concern.

runners_data.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners_data.comment: Modest across its last six starts — a third the highlight — yet still tops our figures with a clear speed edge. Distance-proven and fresh after 34 days off, though a yard managing just 1/26 (4%) in the last fortnight is the concern.

runners_data.name: Twilight Fun
runners_data.comment: A win six starts back is some way back now, with modest form since — including an eighth last time out. Distance-proven and fresh after 24 days off, ranked ninth of eleven on our figures — needs to rediscover that level to feature.

runners_data.name: Rascal Recknell
runners_data.comment: Won three starts back and again five back, sandwiching a sixth, though blank last time out. A lengthy 52-day absence is the obvious query, but distance-proven and ranked seventh of eleven on our figures — capable of running well fresh if repeating its better form.

runners_data.name: Charlie Mason
runners_data.comment: Won two starts back but has faded since, finishing sixth last time out. Distance-proven and fresh after 32 days off, ranked sixth of eleven on our figures — an inconsistent profile overall, with a runner-up effort further back the exception.

runners_data.name: Jumeirah Sands
runners_data.comment: Two wins on the bounce three and two starts back, plus a competitive second last time, make for a solid-looking form file. Distance-proven and fresh after 34 days off, yet ranked only tenth of eleven on our figures — well below her official mark, the obvious concern.

runners_data.name: Manly Fireball
runners_data.comment: Won last time out following a string of places, with only a seventh three starts back interrupting an otherwise consistent run. Distance-proven but 42 days off since, and ranked bottom of eleven on our figures, some way below his official mark — hard to fancy from here.

races.name: Download The At The Races App Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap Stakes (Div I)

runners_data.name: Em Jay Kay
runners_data.comment: A third five starts back was followed by a win, but the three runs since have all been well beaten. Distance-proven and fresh after just 16 days, ranked third of eleven on our figures — the win shows the engine is there, current form the concern.

runners_data.name: Dancing With Drums
runners_data.comment: A winner five starts back, third the start after that, but faded since — a fifth two starts back, ninth last time out. Distance-proven and quick back after 12 days, ranked sixth of eleven on our figures — the recent slide is the worry.

runners_data.name: Quite Sweet
runners_data.comment: A win four starts back is the standout, but the finishes either side have been modest to poor, including a blank last time out. A 172-day absence compounds the concern, and ranked bottom of eleven on our figures, this has plenty to prove on return.

runners_data.name: Sanditon
runners_data.comment: A win three starts back sits amid mostly modest form, including a seventh last time out. Distance-proven and race-fit after just 14 days, but ranked ninth of eleven on our figures — needs more than the odd bright spot to feature.

runners_data.name: Blackjack
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last six starts, with a fourth six starts back the one highlight of a moderate sequence. Distance-proven and fresh after 29 days off, this tops our figures at a push — the modest form file is the obvious reservation.

runners_data.name: Fistral Beach
runners_data.comment: Won four and six starts back but has cooled since, down to seventh last time out after thirds and a second in between. Distance-proven, though a 43-day gap and eighth of eleven on our figures leave this needing more to feature.

runners_data.name: Midnight's Dream
runners_data.comment: A third last time out is easily the best of its last six starts, after a run of blanks. Distance-proven and quick to back up after just 12 days, ranked second of eleven on our figures — the improving trend makes this our pick.

runners_data.name: On Key
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last six starts but rarely out of the frame — three seconds and two thirds, with a fifth the only blip. Quick back within 7 days and distance-proven, ranked fifth of eleven on our figures — the finishing touch is the one thing missing.

runners_data.name: Adelaide Bay
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last six starts, with a pair of seconds the highlight among otherwise rear-of-field finishes. Distance-proven and quick back after just 12 days, ranked seventh of eleven on our figures — the placed efforts offer some hope but consistency is lacking.

runners_data.name: Tommy McJohn
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last five starts, but a third four starts back stands out. Distance-proven and fresh after 18 days off, ranked fourth of eleven on our figures — some way clear of its official mark, with seventh and eighth among the finishes since the concern.

runners_data.name: Twitch
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last five starts, though a second and a third feature among mostly midfield finishes. Distance-proven but 40 days off and ranked tenth of eleven on our figures — needs the form to click to feature.

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap Stakes (Div II)

runners_data.name: Makes Me Wonder
runners_data.comment: Consistently placed without a win, twice runner-up and three times fourth in his last five starts, and has raced over today's trip before. The obvious concern is fitness following a 274-day layoff since his last run, from stall 7 under 132 lb.

runners_data.name: Beaming Light
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last six starts, with finishes between fifth and unplaced showing little sign of an upturn. Has raced over today's trip before and returns 29 days after his latest outing, from stall 9 under 132 lb.

runners_data.name: Macedonian
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, though a fourth five starts back shows a competitive level is in there, and he has raced over today's trip before. Fit again 30 days on, carries 135 lb from stall 10, and tops this field on our rating.

runners_data.name: Cooramook
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time out, third three starts back, but without a win in her last six. Races over today's trip again from stall 6 on a quick 16-day turnaround; a below-par ninth five starts back is the one blot.

runners_data.name: Classy Clarets
runners_data.comment: Won his last two starts, most recently just 6 days ago, after a fifth and a fourth earlier in the campaign. Races over today's trip again from stall 2 under 134 lb; the question is whether that improved form holds with a third quick turnaround.

runners_data.name: Whitesnake
runners_data.comment: Without a win in her last four starts, twice well held in seventh, though a third-placed effort last time out breaks that pattern. Has raced over today's trip before and returns 29 days after that run, but sits bottom of this field on our figures.

runners_data.name: Homme De Fer
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but a model of consistency, with four thirds preceding a fifth-placed run last time out. Has raced over today's trip before, though returns here from a 67-day break and is towards the foot of this field on our figures.

runners_data.name: Dayman
runners_data.comment: Without a win in his last six starts, unplaced last time out, though a runner-up four starts back shows some ability. Has raced over today's trip before and returns from stall 1 under 129 lb, a 54-day break raising a slight fitness question.

runners_data.name: Victory Sound
runners_data.comment: Two thirds in his last two starts are the more encouraging form, with a seventh and two unplaced efforts further back, and only one rival rated below him on our figures. Has raced over today's trip before and is fit again just 15 days on, from stall 4 under 127 lb.

runners_data.name: Roman Secret
runners_data.comment: Third last time out, a winner three starts back, Roman Secret ranks second on our figures with a big test at 140 lb. Proven over today's distance, though a 42-day gap since that latest run is the concern.

runners_data.name: Educate
runners_data.comment: Yet to open his account in his last six starts, but a fair third last time out keeps Educate competitive, and he tops our figures at 140 lb. Fit again 24 days after that run, he wears a tongue-tie and visor and has form over today's trip.

runners_data.name: Luan
runners_data.comment: Luan won last time out but that followed a below-par ninth and an unplaced effort, form that reads inconsistently. Third on our figures and quick to reappear 18 days later, he wears a tongue-tie again, though matching that latest win looks the test.

runners_data.name: Virtual Hug
runners_data.comment: Twice a winner in his last six starts, Virtual Hug was fourth last time out, third the run before. That keeps him fourth on our figures. Proven over today's trip in a tongue-tie and cheekpieces, though a 31-day absence leaves a fitness question.

runners_data.name: Nala The Lioness
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time out, a winner the start before, Nala The Lioness has returned to form after modest efforts earlier. Fifth on our figures and wearing a tongue-tie again, she has form over today's trip but needs to confirm that improvement.

runners_data.name: Wonderful Wendy
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time out after modest efforts before that, Wonderful Wendy is yet to score in her last four starts. She has form over today's trip, sits seventh on our figures, and a fair speed figure offers some encouragement despite the 38-day gap since that run.

runners_data.name: Come On John
runners_data.comment: Come On John has managed just one fourth-placed finish among five recent starts, remaining winless with little consistency. Sixth on our figures and wearing a visor again, he does have form over today's trip, though a 42-day break clouds fitness claims.

runners_data.name: Late Claim
runners_data.comment: Third last time out but without a win in her last six starts, Late Claim sits eighth on our figures. She wears a tongue-tie and cheekpieces again, has form over today's trip, and returns 25 days after that latest effort.

runners_data.name: Blue Tulip
runners_data.comment: Blue Tulip has managed nothing better than fifth across three recent starts, well below an official mark of 55 and eleventh on our figures. A fair speed figure is the one plus, but she returns 27 days after that modest effort and looks held on this evidence.

runners_data.name: A Daughters Love
runners_data.comment: A Daughters Love arrives having won her last two starts, following a pair of thirds before that. Yet she rates only ninth on our figures, some way below an official mark of 54, and quick to reappear just 10 days after that latest success.

runners_data.name: Galistra
runners_data.comment: Galistra has been no better than fifth in three recent starts, sitting tenth on our figures well below an official mark of 52. She has form over today's trip and a decent speed figure, though a 28-day absence since that modest effort is another query.

runners_data.name: Crazy Plan
runners_data.comment: Crazy Plan has failed to place in any of her last three starts, the best a seventh, and rates bottom of our figures at 43 against an official mark of 51. A 50-day absence since that run adds to the concerns, leaving little to recommend her chance.
